description: Equality chains against literals act as an inline allowlist: on the equal edge the variable holds a constant, and a `||` / `&&` chain is split per clause so the join intersects the per-edge facts. The not-equal edge, a post-join sink and a disjunct on another variable stay tainted.

expected.notes: `dir === 'asc' || dir === 'desc'` and the `!==` early return pin dir to a literal
sink after the join of an equality guard on a logging branch
`dir === 'asc' || flag` lets any dir through when flag is set
